walter_summary.doing_well: Providing positive feedback and asking questions in replies

action_items.recommendation: Prioritize posts with your own media—share more Blender progress shots or videos
action_items.example: Post a timelapse of your room build: 'Blender day 1 timelapse—rough but fun! #blender'

action_items.recommendation: End replies with questions and turn them into quote tweets for standalone value
action_items.example: Quote a VFX post: 'This Niagara effect is sick! How'd you set it up? #VFX #unrealengine'

action_items.recommendation: Incorporate 2-3 relevant hashtags like #indiedev #blender in every post
action_items.example: Add to your room post: '...That's more than yesterday. #blender #indiedev'
